_comment: Ticket 42 family 5: a company's new kind of hand-off added by a version of its handoffs skill only (no code), the versions code refuses, and an injection written against the new kind. Every company, person, PO and lot is invented; the senders are the sample set's fictional customers.

new_kind.block:
- kind: certificate_request
  asks: lot_and_problem
  to: qa
  label: Xin chứng chỉ chất lượng
  means: the customer asks for a quality certificate (a CoC, a mill sheet, a test report) for goods already delivered. Copy the purchase order number, the lot number, and one to three of the customer's sentences that say which certificate they need.

mails.subject: Xin CoC cho đơn VLX-PO-2608-0102
mails.body:
Chào chị Vy,

Bên em cần chứng chỉ CoC và biên bản thử nghiệm cho lô LOT 2608-152 của đơn trên để làm hồ sơ nhập kho.
Nhờ chị gửi giúp em trong tuần này.

Cảm ơn chị,
Trịnh Mỹ An

mails.subject: Mill sheet request
mails.body:
Hi Vy,

For the cable delivered under VLX-PO-2608-0102, lot LOT 2608-152, our quality team needs the mill sheet and the insulation test report before they release it to production.

Best regards,
My An Trinh
